maker: China Construction Decoration Group (CSCEC Decoration), Overseas Decoration unit
name: CSCEC Decoration indoor mobile layout robot 2.0
summary: Small cake-shaped layout robot from a CSCEC fit-out company that drives on castor wheels and marks layout points on interior floors from a tablet task list, positioned by a robotic total station. Shown in its second version at the 2025 Wuhan intelligent construction fair.

germany.statusNote: Developed by a unit of the Chinese state contractor CSCEC as a 'hardware + software + service' package for its own interior works; no sale outside China and no European route found.

specs.label: Body size
specs.quote: 通体只有22cm却能够实现2mm精度的放线打点工作

specs.label: Point marking accuracy
specs.quote: 通体只有22cm却能够实现2mm精度的放线打点工作

specs.label: Layout per day
specs.quote: 2人一组，每天可完成400㎡放线工作

specs.label: System parts
specs.value: high-frequency robotic total station, control tablet, robot, layout workflow software
specs.quote: 由高频测量全站仪、测量放线控制平板、放线机器人本体三部分组成

specs.label: Sensors
specs.quote: 搭载高频测量模块、避障传感雷达、全自动化处理

notes: Universal castor wheels under the body ('底部配备万向轮').
Made for interior (indoor) layout of fit-out work, including irregular shapes.
Version 2.0 is said to be improved over 1.0 in functions, cost and site fit; marking method (ink, pen) not stated.

evidence.task: Shown marking layout points automatically at the stand
evidence.where: 2025 International (Wuhan) Intelligent Construction Industry Expo, Wuhan, China
evidence.note: Trade fair debut of version 2.0 (31 Oct – 2 Nov 2025).
